notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier; maps to person_source_value to link all records to the same individual.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored as an Observation with a custom concept; no standard concept_id exists for NHANES weights.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored as an Observation with a custom concept; no standard concept_id exists.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/quality of recall. Maps to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept; no standard OMOP concept for this specific NHANES status.
Interviewer ID code is an operational identifier, not a clinical concept. Stored as an Observation string value for provenance.
Breast-fed infant indicator. Concept_id 4076740 represents 'Breastfeeding status' or a similar binary concept; alternatively a custom Yes/No concept.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as numeric value; no standard concept for 'number of dietary recall days'.
Days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric value. Stored as value_as_number with a custom concept.
Intake day of the week is categorical (e.g., Monday-Sunday). No standard OMOP concept for day of week; use custom concept.
Language used mostly. Concept_id 4075809 is 'Language' or a specific language concept; may require mapping to ISO language concepts.
Main respondent indicator (self vs proxy). No standard OMOP concept; use custom concept for respondent type.
Helped in responding indicator. No standard OMOP concept; use custom concept for interview assistance.
Type of table salt used (e.g., regular, lite, sea salt). No standard OMOP concept; map to custom concept or SNOMED salt product concepts.
Frequency of adding salt at table (ordinal: never, rarely, sometimes, always). No standard OMOP concept; use custom concept for salt use frequency.
Salt used in preparation (ordinal: never, rarely, sometimes, always). No standard OMOP concept; use custom concept for salt use in cooking.
